Type:        PARTITION
Name:        Partition
Category:    transformers
Description: Receives data through connected input port, splits incoming data flow into more flows and sends each of them to different connected output port.
Usage:       When to use: Route each record to a specific output port based on content — value ranges, hash of a key field, or CTL2 logic returning a port number. Content-aware routing.
             Constraints: Record goes to exactly one port. Define routing via ranges, partitionKey (hash-based), or partitionSource (CTL2).

Input Ports:
  [0] (required)
Output Ports:
  [*] (min 1 required)

Properties:
  partitionSource [attr-cdata]: [transformPartition]  Defines the partitioning logic used to split data into multiple output streams.
  partitionURL: [file]  Specifies the path or URL for partition url.
  partitionClass: [class]  Specifies the Java class that implements custom partitioning logic.
  ranges: [ranges]  Defines the value ranges used for partitioning data.
  partitionKey: [key]  Defines the key fields used to partition data into separate output files based on field values.
  charset: [charset]  Defines the character encoding used to encode/decode file content. If not specified, the system will attempt to detect or use the default encoding.
  locale: [locale]  Specifies the locale used for string comparison and sorting operations.
  useI18N: [bool]  (default: false)  When enabled, uses internationalization settings for string operations.

To configure it, call component_get_guide("PARTITION") — full attribute reference with allowed values, defaults, and worked mapping/transform examples this surface view omits. Don't re-run component_get_info on the same type; if the properties above aren't enough, escalate to component_get_guide.
